# zsh

The shell: zsh with oh-my-zsh (agnoster prompt, git plugin).

`.zshrc` puts `~/.local/bin` first on `PATH`, so this repo's commands (`theme`, `screenshot`, `osd-volume` …) work by name. `setup.sh` clones oh-my-zsh into `~/.oh-my-zsh` only if it is missing (it updates itself) and makes zsh the login shell.

## Reference

<!-- generated by tools/docs: reference -->
**Packages** (`zsh/packages`): `zsh`, `git` (oh-my-zsh is a git checkout and updates itself)

**Linked into your home** (stow, `install.sh --link`):

- `~/.zshrc`

**`setup.sh`** (run by `install.sh --setup`): oh-my-zsh in ~/.oh-my-zsh (only if missing; it updates itself afterwards) and zsh as the login shell. Idempotent. ~/.zshrc itself is linked by install.sh.
